segment_contamination_dimensions: Bamboo and natural-material hut buyers (resort, eco-tourism, hospitality) — a handcrafted, aesthetics-driven segment with a fundamentally different buyer persona and price tier from the factory-manufactured steel/FRP portable hut segment; sibling MCAT 'Bamboo Huts' (ID 141758) owns this segment exclusively, so any name evoking bamboo, eco-hut, nature hut, or resort-style hut is blocked.

Guard-hut-only buyers — sibling MCATs 'Guard Huts' (ID 42751) and 'PVC Guard Huts' (ID 132218) carve out the dedicated security-cabin segment; names that exclusively target guard/security cabin buyers (e.g. 'Security Guard Prefab Hut') are blocked to avoid direct collision, though guard hut remains a valid secondary application within this MCAT.

Portable-house residential buyers — siblings 'Portable House' (ID 88195) and 'Mild Steel Portable House' (ID 315617) serve buyers seeking residential-grade portable homes; names framing the product as a portable house or home are blocked.

Bunkhouse-specific buyers — siblings 'Bunkhouses' (ID 23898), 'MS Bunkhouse' (ID 150851), 'Prefab Steel Bunk House' (ID 133097), and 'Bunk House Office' (ID 133091) own the bunkhouse label; any name using 'bunkhouse' or 'bunk house' is blocked.
